steps.description: DB reconciliation: derive header totals from actual saved line values (FE-computed, tax-reconciled). Eliminates rounding drift  -  NOT recalculation, just aggregation from DB source of truth.
steps.sql: WITH line_agg AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(tax_amount_fc), 0) AS tax_fc, COALESCE(SUM(amount_fc), 0) AS amount_fc, COALESCE(SUM(discount_amount_fc), 0) AS discount_fc, COUNT(*) AS line_cnt FROM uni_app.ul_doc_lines WHERE doc_id = :doc_id::uuid AND tenant_id = :tenant_id::uuid AND is_deleted = false), tax_agg AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS tax_cnt FROM uni_app.ul_doc_line_taxes WHERE doc_id = :doc_id::uuid AND tenant_id = :tenant_id::uuid AND is_deleted = false) UPDATE uni_app.ul_doc_headers SET total_tax_fc = t.tax_fc, total_tax_bc = ROUND(t.tax_fc * exchange_rate, 3), total_amount_fc = t.amount_fc, total_amount_bc = ROUND(t.amount_fc * exchange_rate, 3), total_discount_fc = t.discount_fc, total_discount_bc = ROUND(t.discount_fc * exchange_rate, 3), grand_total_fc = t.amount_fc - t.discount_fc + t.tax_fc, grand_total_bc = ROUND((t.amount_fc - t.discount_fc + t.tax_fc) * exchange_rate, 3), line_count = t.line_cnt, tax_count = tx.tax_cnt, version_no = uni_app.ul_doc_headers.version_no + 1 FROM line_agg t, tax_agg tx WHERE doc_id = :doc_id::uuid AND tenant_id = :tenant_id::uuid RETURNING doc_id, version_no, line_count

steps.description: Reconcile per-line child counts (serial_count, discount_count) from actual child rows  -  Phase 0 count integrity
steps.sql: UPDATE uni_app.ul_doc_lines l SET serial_count = COALESCE(s.cnt, 0), discount_count = COALESCE(d.cnt, 0) FROM (SELECT line_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM uni_app.ul_doc_line_serials WHERE doc_id = :doc_id::uuid AND tenant_id = :tenant_id::uuid AND is_deleted = false GROUP BY line_id) s FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT line_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM uni_app.ul_doc_line_discounts WHERE doc_id = :doc_id::uuid AND tenant_id = :tenant_id::uuid GROUP BY line_id) d ON s.line_id = d.line_id WHERE l.doc_id = :doc_id::uuid AND l.tenant_id = :tenant_id::uuid AND l.is_deleted = false AND l.line_id = COALESCE(s.line_id, d.line_id)
